text:
elaine (oncall): seeing apiserver 504s + etcd election churn in eu-west-4 after some DNS flaps. GPU onboarding backlog climbing and many pods Pending. anyone on call? :thinking:

marco: DNS provider reported a brief authoritative delay and some TTL bounce. kubelets failing to resolve our object-store endpoint intermittently. snapshot uploads timing out.

tara: etcd leader moved 3x in ~4m, commit latency spiked >500ms. leader node iowait is high, disk queue depth elevated. controller-manager logs show repeated watch reconnects and leader-election failures.

cloud-ops: we observed resolver errors ~09:12 (90s). added extra forwarders, lowered cache TTL for storage endpoint, bumped SNAT ephemeral ports, and granted a temporary IOPS credit to the etcd leader volume for 45m.

elaine (oncall): quick state dumps i pulled:
```bash
# kubectl -n kube-system get pods -l component=etcd -o wide
etcd-ew4-0   1/1 Running        0   2h   10.5.1.8  eu-west-4a
etcd-ew4-1   0/1 CrashLoopBackOff 6   1h  10.5.2.9  eu-west-4b
```

marco: controller-manager logs show: "failed to acquire lease" -> retries -> "lease acquired" -> lost again.

tara: scheduler view: ~80 GPU pods Pending. common reasons: "Insufficient cpu" and "failed to pull snapshot: i/o timeout". nodes that could host GPUs were briefly losing access to object-store and getting labelled NotReady.

elaine (oncall): mitigation plan: (1) pause large model artifact uploads, (2) reduce controller concurrency and lengthen leader-election lease, (3) spin up a small relaxed-taint GPU nodepool for immediate drain, (4) reconfigure DNS forwarders and monitor resolver errors.

marco: applying controller-manager patch now:
```bash
kubectl -n kube-system patch deploy kube-controller-manager --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"kube-controller-manager","args":["--leader-elect=true","--leader-elect-lease-duration=30s","--leader-elect-renew-deadline=20s","--concurrent-deployment-syncs=1"]}]}}}}'
```

infra-bot: alert: etcd_commit_latency > 400ms (eu-west-4) — incident INC-9001 created.

cloud-ops: DNS forwarders added, TTL lowered for storage endpoint, SNAT/IOPS bump active. seeing fewer DNS NXDOMAIN spikes and reduced socket timeouts to storage.

tara: after changes: GPU Pending down from ~80 -> ~34 in 15m, apiserver 5xxs back to baseline. watch latency still elevated but trending down.

elaine (oncall): post-incident actions: (a) add DNS forwarder redundancy and TTL guidance to runbook, (b) evaluate leader-election defaults and watcher backoff as part of controller hardening, (c) add gating to pause large artifact uploads when control-plane latency > 250ms, (d) assess cost/benefit for permanent IOPS buffer on etcd leader for onboarding windows.

marco: opening RFC for DNS changes and an IOPS buffer plan; tagging cost and infra teams.

elaine (oncall): leaving incident open for 30m of stable metrics. thanks team. :thumbsup:
